description: HDD and SSD diagnostics: drive passport and S.M.A.R.T., surface scan with remap of bad sectors, NVMe, SCSI and USB drives.
notes: Runs as administrator: Windows shows a UAC prompt on every start.
Start it from the 'Victoria' shortcut in Scoop Apps: the shortcut starts it in its own folder,
where it keeps Victoria.ini and the LOGS folder (event logs and the S.M.A.R.T. database).
Both are persisted and survive updates.
Write and Erase tests and the Remap, Erase and Refresh scan actions write to the drive: back up first.
To forbid all writes, check 'Disable dangerous features' in Settings.
